# OMA-AI API

> Multi-provider AI gateway with 300+ models. OpenAI-compatible API. Pay-per-request with USDC stablecoin credits.

## Overview

OMA-AI routes requests to multiple upstream providers (Venice, Surplus). OpenAI-compatible chat completions API with per-token billing via USDC credits. Models span budget, mid, premium, and frontier categories.

## Base URL

```
https://api.oma-ai.com/v1
```

## Authentication

All requests require Bearer token (API key) or session cookie.

```
Authorization: Bearer sk-your-api-key
```

Or cookie: `oma_api_key=sk-your-api-key`. Keys can be scoped to specific models and IP allowlists. Keys older than 90 days trigger `X-Key-Rotation-Recommended` header.

## Chat Completions

```
POST /v1/chat/completions
```

OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports streaming (SSE), tool/function calling, and structured responses.

**Request body:**
- `model` (string, required) — model ID (e.g. `deepseek-v3.2`, `llama-3.3-70b`)
- `messages` (array, required) — 1-100 messages, roles: `system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`
- `temperature` (number, 0-2, optional)
- `max_tokens` (integer, optional)
- `stream` (boolean, optional) — enables SSE streaming
- `tools` (array, optional) — function/tool definitions
- `response_format` (object, optional)

**Limits:** 10 MB max request body, 1 MB total message content, 100 KB per message.

**Streaming:** Set `"stream": true` to receive Server-Sent Events (SSE) with `Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Responses include `x-provider` header indicating the upstream provider.

**Idempotency:** Pass `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

## Models

```
GET /v1/models          — list all available models
GET /v1/models/:id      — get a single model
```

Models are categorized as `budget`, `mid`, `premium`, or `frontier`. Each model returns per-token pricing:
- `pricing.prompt` — cost per input token
- `pricing.completion` — cost per output token
- `context_length` — max context window
- `category` — budget | mid | premium | frontier
- `supports_streaming` — whether streaming is supported

## Embeddings

```
POST /v1/embeddings
```

- `model` (string, required) — embedding model ID
- `input` (string | string[], required) — text to embed

## Credits

```
GET  /v1/credits/balance          — current balance and active batches
POST /v1/credits/purchase         — create a deposit (USDC, SOL)
GET  /v1/credits/transactions     — recent deposits and usage
GET  /v1/credits/usage            — aggregated usage by model
GET  /v1/credits/price-estimate   — estimate cost for model + tokens
POST /v1/credits/auto-reload      — configure auto-reload
GET  /v1/credits/auto-reload      — get auto-reload settings
POST /v1/credits/refund/:usageId  — refund a usage record
POST /v1/credits/budget-alerts    — set budget alert thresholds
GET  /v1/credits/budget-alerts    — get budget alert config
```

Credits = cents (1 credit = $0.01). Deposits accept USDC on Ethereum or Solana. Auto-reload tops up when balance drops below threshold.

## Usage

```
GET /v1/usage?days=30       — aggregated usage (totals, by model, by provider)
GET /v1/usage/recent?limit=20 — recent individual requests
```

Session authentication required for usage endpoints.

## Pricing

Per-token pricing varies by model. Prices are per 1M tokens:
- **Budget** (e.g. Llama 3.2 3B): ~$0.06/M input, ~$0.12/M output
- **Mid** (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B): ~$0.35/M input, ~$0.90/M output
- **Premium** (e.g. DeepSeek V3.2): ~$0.50/M input, ~$1.50/M output
- **Frontier**: variable

A provider markup (default 10-25%) is included in displayed prices. Minimum charge: 1 credit per request.

## Error Responses

All errors follow this structure:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "string",
    "type": "invalid_request_error | authentication_error | server_error | forbidden",
    "code": "model_not_found | expired_api_key | ip_not_allowed | request_too_large"
  }
}
```

**Common HTTP status codes:**
- `400` — validation error, model not found, request too large
- `401` — missing/invalid API key, expired key, invalid session
- `403` — IP not allowed, model not allowed for this key, admin required
- `404` — model not found
- `413` — request body exceeds 10 MB limit
- `429` — rate limit exceeded (token bucket: 60 RPM per user)
- `500` — internal server error
- `503` — authentication service unavailable

**Insufficient credits:** Returns a payment request object to top up balance.

## Rate Limits

- Token bucket: 60 RPM, refill rate 20/sec, bucket size 60
- Per-model rate limits enforced
- Spend limits configurable per API key

## Documentation

Full documentation: https://oma-ai.com/docs
